wiki.title: Marianne Moore (politician)
wiki.extract: Marianne Moore is an American politician from Maine. Moore, a Republican, was elected to the Maine Senate in 2018 (District 6). She is a resident of Calais, Maine and previously served as mayor. In the Legislature, Moore represents a largely rural district covering Washington County, Maine. In 2019, Moore co-sponsored a bill to end "food-shaming" in public schools. It "prohibits punishing, openly identifying or stigmatizing a student who cannot pay or who has payments due."
